description: This file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Tag' which is part of the Smarty template engine. The class constructs and manages parse tree nodes representing Smarty tags within the template parsing process, including methods for generating PHP code snippets from template data.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Tag
classes.description: Represents a complete Smarty tag within the parse tree, capable of generating PHP code for rendering the tag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parse tree node with the given parser context and tag data.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Returns the raw template content stored in this parse tree node.

methods.name: assign_to_var
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate the tag content and assign it to a temporary variable.
